field_principles.action_influence_replay_rows: Influence rows require a measured deterministic score change.
field_principles.agent_factory_trace_rows: Executed calls prove reachability beyond a source reference.
field_principles.arc_contract_audit_complete_score: Completion requires a terminal result for every fixture row.
field_principles.arc_producer_contract_confirmed_score: Confirmation requires integrity, routing, and source agreement.
field_principles.atomicity_replay_rows: Atomicity rows prove stopped writes have no final marker.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time shows that the fresh audit process executed.
field_principles.eligibility_replay_rows: Independent decisions show which records can support later science.
field_principles.engine_hash_replay_rows: Engine hashes identify the executable candidate exactly.
field_principles.envelope_hash_replay_rows: Envelope replay detects content drift without a hash cycle.
field_principles.environment_hash_replay_rows: Environment hashes bind the producer runtime receipt.
field_principles.factory_hash_replay_rows: Factory hashes bind evidence to the shipped constructor.
field_principles.field_principles: A reason for every field makes the audit contract reviewable.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Exact expected and observed values explain any blocked audit.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A class-specific prefix gives automation a stable terminal result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate separates a byte replay from LLM or game execution.
field_principles.legacy_replay_rows: Legacy rows stay readable without receiving current eligibility.
field_principles.level_claimed: A score change does not prove level completion.
field_principles.manifest_hash_replay_rows: Manifest replay checks the final eligibility marker.
field_principles.model_quality_claimed: Contract integrity does not establish model quality.
field_principles.per_fixture_rows: One summary per fixture exposes omissions and duplicate credit.
field_principles.policy_hash_replay_rows: Policy hashes bind evidence to the shipped routing code.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact preflight checks stop missing source evidence from looking audited.
field_principles.prompt_hash_replay_rows: Prompt replay binds synthesis to the raw request bytes.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed identifies the deterministic fixture run.
field_principles.read_only_enforcement_receipt: Sandbox evidence proves the audit could not change its sources.
field_principles.registry_updated: A read-only fixture audit must preserve the solve registry.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A timing-free digest detects scientific-content drift.
field_principles.routing_replay_rows: Routing rows bind the envelope engine to the real candidate seam.
field_principles.rows: Terminal row records preserve every decision denominator.
field_principles.scorer_hash_replay_rows: Scorer hashes fix the measurement code used by the producer.
field_principles.solve_claimed: An evidence replay does not prove a game solve.
field_principles.solve_provenance_applicable: A fixture contract has no solve provenance to assess.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Input hashes bind the audit to exact source and fixture bytes.
field_principles.source_disagreement_rows: Contradictions between replay and source claims remain visible.
field_principles.source_kind_rows: Source rows reject evidence not produced by live attempts.
field_principles.submitted_to_leaderboard: A local byte audit is not a leaderboard submission.
field_principles.tamper_replay_rows: Attack rows show that changed evidence fails closed.
field_principles.transition_hash_replay_rows: Transition hashes bind values and serialization order.
field_principles.transition_order_rows: Order rows prevent a valid set from hiding an invalid sequence.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed verdict class prevents blocked work from reading as positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False separates contract validation from a game oracle.
